about_the_game:
Game Background

The sun shines on the picturesque streets of the town, the alleys with blooming flowers, the wooden bridges surrounded by gurgling streams, and the European-style cottages shaded by green trees, forming a beautiful picture. You strolled in this tourist resort, sighing at its tranquility and charm, but did not notice the danger quietly spreading in the shadows...

A heart-warming and dangerous love adventure is about to be set off in the sunny town. Unlock their beautiful illustrations through three eliminations and erasures.

Gameplay

Complete the goal to unlock your girlfriend's beautiful illustrations and plots by matching the three elimination levels of town elements. Uncover the beautiful illustrations of your girlfriends, from daily interactions to private thoughts, just like touching their hearts with your own hands

Character introduction

Rika (27 years old, flower shop owner): Light golden curly hair is fluffy and natural, reaching her chest, and her emerald green eyes are gentle and smart, like a forest elf.

Luya (20 years old, street painter): Gray medium-length hair is messy and stylish, with an artistic atmosphere. She wears glasses in private to show her true nature as a home girl, and her blue eyes always have a sleepy laziness.

Naho (22 years old, swimming coach): Chestnut high ponytail is capable and wild, black skin exudes a healthy luster, brown eyes are fiery and firm, and two tiger teeth smile sweetly and movingly.

Natsumi (29 years old, flower shop partner): Dark red waist-length hair is slightly curled like silk, exudes the scent of rose perfume, and amber eyes are warm but hide cold possessiveness.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains common adult content such as slightly revealing clothing and provocative poses

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows7/8/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Gef750
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

short_description: During the game, you mainly match a certain amount of identical game elements, such as fruits, gems, building blocks, etc., so that they are adjacent to each other to eliminate them to win. Match three or more identical elements to eliminate them, complete the set goals.
